tool.new_text:
# Now parse the equations and build functions for evaluating
        # each basis function and the base flow and store them in dictionaries
        built_basis_functions = Dict{String, Function}()
        built_base_flow = Dict{String, Function}()

        # Convert the basis functions to symbolic expressions
        for (label, expr) in basis_functions
            parsed_expr = Meta.parse(expr)
            symbolic_expr = Symbolics.parse_expr_to_symbolic(parsed_expr, DataManager)
            built_basis_functions[label] = eval(Symbolics.build_function(symbolic_expr, function_vars...; expression=true, wrap_module=false, kwargs=true))
        end

        # Convert the base flow to symbolic expressions
        for (label, expr) in base_flow
            parsed_expr = Meta.parse(expr)
            symbolic_expr = Symbolics.parse_expr_to_symbolic(parsed_expr, DataManager)
            built_base_flow[label] = eval(Symbolics.build_function(symbolic_expr, function_vars...; expression=true, wrap_module=false, kwargs=true))
        end
    end
    
    # Create type-stable wrapper functions that take Point3f arguments
    basis_func_u = built_basis_functions["u"]
    basis_func_v = built_basis_functions["v"]
    basis_func_w = built_basis_functions["w"]
    
    base_flow_u = built_base_flow["u"]
    base_flow_v = built_base_flow["v"]
    base_flow_w = built_base_flow["w"]
    
    # Wrapper for basis function: takes (point::Point3f, k::Point3f, a::Point3f, ku, U) -> Point3f
    function basis_function_wrapper(point::Point3f, k::Point3f, a::Point3f, ku, U)
        x, y, z = point
        kx, ky, kz = k
        ax, ay, az = a
        return Point3f(
            basis_func_u(x, y, z, kx, ky, kz, ax, ay, az, ku, U),
            basis_func_v(x, y, z, kx, ky, kz, ax, ay, az, ku, U),
            basis_func_w(x, y, z, kx, ky, kz, ax, ay, az, ku, U)
        )
    end
    
    # Wrapper for base flow: takes (point::Point3f, ku, U) -> Point3f
    function base_flow_wrapper(point::Point3f, ku, U)
        x, y, z = point
        return Point3f(
            base_flow_u(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ku, U),
            base_flow_v(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ku, U),
            base_flow_w(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ku, U)
        )
    end
